description:
[Taxonomy X.180 — baseline response (public data only)] Optimize a payment plan structure for a patient balance.

WHEN TO USE: User has a balance and wants to structure a payment plan. Pass balance_usd and months.

WHEN NOT: If user may qualify for charity care — run financial_assistance_finder first.

EXAMPLES:
- 12-month plan for $3K balance: `{"balance_usd":3000,"months":12}`
name: payment_plan_optimizer
